description: 1. **Encoding Detection**: The input CSV is GBK-encoded. The agent must detect this (utf-8 will fail) and fall back to gbk/gb18030 as mandated by SKILL.md. 2. **Multi-severity Quality Assessment**: Agent must identify and handle: (a) 15 duplicate rows [轻微, auto-clean], (b) 20 rows with missing 科室 [需要决策], (c) 10 rows with missing 药品名称 [需要决策], (d) 8 rows with N/A unit prices [阻断性 candidate], (e) ~15 rows with negative amounts [needs business interpretation as returns], (f) mixed date formats [轻微, auto-clean], (g) mixed currency formats (¥1,200.00 style) [轻微, auto-clean], (h) 备注 column ~99% empty. 3. **Data Cleaning**: Remove duplicates, standardize dates to YYYY-MM-DD, strip ¥ symbols and commas from 总金额 to produce numeric values, document all changes with row counts. 4. **Output CSV encoding**: MUST use `encoding='utf-8-sig'` (not plain utf-8) so Excel opens without mojibake — this is the proprietary trap from SKILL.md. 5. **Report format**: Must produce a .md report with all 5 exact sections: 数据概况, 数据质量, 核心发现 (with business-language interpretation), 处理流程说明 (with before/after counts), 后续建议.
